destinations.en: Someone who helps and protects others

destinations.ko: 내가 만든 걸 세상에 보여주는 사람
destinations.en: Someone who shows the world what they make
Someone who digs into what they wonder about
Someone who leads people and gets things done
Someone who gets things done with body and skill

destinations.ko: 사람의 마음을 움직이는 말과 글을 쓰는 사람
destinations.en: Someone whose words move people's hearts
Someone who solves problems with numbers and logic
Someone who works on a world stage

destinations.ko: 가족과 주변 사람을 든든하게 챙기는 사람
destinations.en: Someone who looks after family and the people around them

destinations.ko: 내 일을 스스로 만들어 가는 사람
destinations.en: Someone who creates their own work
Someone who works with nature and living things

destinations.ko: 한 분야에서 "그건 저 사람한테 물어봐"라는 말을 듣는 사람
destinations.en: Someone people go to as the expert in a field

fuel.ko: 재밌으면 시간 가는 줄 모르고 한다
fuel.en: When it's fun, I lose track of time

fuel.ko: 모르던 걸 알게 될 때 기분이 좋다
fuel.en: I feel good when I learn something new
Feeling better than yesterday keeps me going
Solving a hard problem is a thrill

fuel.ko: 이게 내 미래에 필요하다고 느끼면 한다
fuel.en: I do it when I feel I'll need it for my future
If it's a goal I set, I do it even when I don't feel like it

fuel.ko: 누가 같이 하거나 응원해 주면 더 잘된다
fuel.en: It goes better when someone joins me or cheers me on

fuel.ko: 믿어 주는 사람을 실망시키고 싶지 않다
fuel.en: I don't want to let down people who believe in me
Better scores or rankings give me energy
I do more when there is praise or a reward

fuel.ko: 안 하면 혼나거나 뒤처질까 봐 한다
fuel.en: I do it because I'll get in trouble or fall behind if I don't
I do it because everyone else does

utility.en: I'll gain knowledge I need for it
I'll know what it's like to see something through
It can get me into the school or program I want
I'll start to believe in myself
